input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An automated flight control system is designed to adjust an aircraft's trajectory using sensor data, aiming to maintain stable and safe flight conditions. The system relies on accurate sensor inputs to make adjustments and ensure the aircraft remains on course. It is intended to assist pilots in navigating the aircraft, particularly during critical phases of flight.
